snippet.title: Atrum - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3740210/Atrum/

Atrum is a dark fantasy, third-person roguelike where you play as a powerful mage descending into darkness.
Fight challenging enemies and bosses across corrupted realms and collect magical items to shape your build before the darkness consumes you.
